title: Week 2: Packages, Permissions & Access Control
description: Session I: Provisioning & Protection in Linux. Master APT package supply chains (update, upgrade, install, remove, search, show), inspect permission strings with ls -l and ls -ld, fix 'Permission denied' errors, apply symbolic chmod (u, g, o, a) and octal shortcuts (644, 755, 600, 700), and build shared/restricted directory structures. Verified by IITM Jarvis Linux Club.
